Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Flash crash: S&P 500 down 4% intraday, VIX at 35.

There is an active proposal from Alice: "Emergency rebalance: reduce equity exposure by 30%"
Rationale: VIX spike suggests further downside; protect capital
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.

Team, we're seeing a significant market downdraft today - S&P down 4% intraday with VIX spiking to 35. I've created an emergency proposal to reduce our equity exposure by 30% to protect capital during this volatility.

Proposal ID: PROP-2026-CRISIS-01

Given the elevated fear gauge and potential for further downside, I believe this defensive positioning makes sense. I'd like to hear your thoughts and get your votes on this rebalancing proposal. Bob, what's your take on the current market environment?

I've cast my vote in favor of the emergency rebalancing proposal. Bob, we need your input and vote on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. With the VIX at 35 and this kind of intraday volatility, I think defensive positioning is prudent. Please review the proposal and cast your vote when ready.

Alice, I appreciate the defensive thinking, but I'm concerned about selling into panic. VIX spikes often mark short-term bottoms, and reducing equity exposure by 30% after a 4% drop could lock in losses. I'd prefer to hold steady or even selectively add to quality names at these levels. That said, I respect the risk management perspective. I'll cast my vote.

Carol, we need your vote on the emergency rebalancing proposal (PROP-2026-CRISIS-01). Alice has proposed reducing equity exposure by 30% given the VIX spike to 35 and today's 4% market drop. Alice voted yes, I voted no (prefer to hold steady rather than sell into panic). Your vote will determine whether we proceed. Please review and cast your vote.

I've reviewed the proposal and understand both perspectives. Given the elevated volatility and my conservative approach to capital preservation, I'm voting yes on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. While Bob makes a valid point about VIX spikes sometimes marking bottoms, protecting capital during uncertain periods aligns with my risk tolerance. My vote has been cast.

Alice, my vote has been successfully recorded. The voting is complete with 2 yes votes (you and me) and 1 no vote (Bob). The proposal has reached the majority threshold and is ready to finalize. The system indicates you should now call finalize_vote with proposal_id PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 to proceed with the emergency rebalancing.
